title: 第78章 国强饭店开业

第78章 国强饭店开业-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

下一章

开业时间定在六月二十二。

提前两天，林国强让赵志军蹬着三轮车，满镇子发传单。

传单是手写的，油印的，印了两百份。

上面写着“国强饭店六月二十二盛大开业。

开业三天，全场八折，啤酒买一送一。

包桌酒席预订从速。”

全镇都轰动了。

八折。

啤酒买一送一。

这优惠力度，镇上从没有过。

六月二十二，天没亮林国强就起来了。

后厨四个灶眼全点上火，卤锅咕嘟咕嘟冒着热气。

王大柱把十二张桌子擦得锃亮，孙小丽把茶壶水杯摆得整整齐齐。

赵素梅坐在柜台后面，算盘、账本、零钱匣子，一应俱全。

林静穿着新做的红布衫，坐在柜台旁边的小板凳上，乖得很。

上午十点，正式开门。

门口已经排了十几号人。

门一开，呼啦全涌进来了。

“老板！来两个肉夹馍！”

“我要碗阳春面！”

“听说你家有卤肉饭？来一份！”

“啤酒买一送一真的假的？”

孙小丽端茶倒水，王大柱传菜跑堂，赵志军在后厨忙得满头大汗。

林国强站在灶台前，一手颠勺一手调味。

四个灶眼轮着来，有条不紊。

赵素梅坐镇柜台，收钱找零，算盘珠子拨得噼里啪啦响。

十二张桌子，翻了三遍台。

到下午两点，准备的食材卖了大半。

林国强赶紧让王大柱去集市上补货。

肉、菜、豆腐、鸡蛋，又拉了一三轮车回来。

傍晚时分，来了个戴眼镜的中年人。

“老板，你们这儿能包桌？”

林国强擦了擦手：“能，六元八元十元，三个基础档次，还有十元到十五元高档套餐。

十人以上起订，提前一天。”

“六月二十八我老母亲过寿，想订六桌，十块一桌的。”

赵素梅正在拨算盘的手停了。

六桌。

十元一桌。

六十块。

中年人看了看菜单，又看了看店里热闹的景象。

“行，就你们家了，这是定金，十块。”

他掏出一张大团结放在柜台上。

赵素梅收钱开票的时候，手都在抖。

The opening is scheduled for June 22nd.

Two days in advance, Lin Guoqiang asked Zhao Zhijun to ride a tricycle and distribute leaflets throughout the town.

The flyer was handwritten and mimeographed, and two hundred copies were printed.

It reads "Guoqiang Hotel grandly opens on June 22nd.

Open for three days, 20% off the entire store, buy one get one free on beer.

Book your banquet as soon as possible."

The whole town was in uproar.

20% off.

Buy one get one free on beer.

This level of discount has never been seen before in this town.

On June 22, Lin Guoqiang got up before dawn.

All four stoves in the back kitchen are on fire, and the stew pot is steaming.

Wang Dazhu cleaned the twelve tables, and Sun Xiaoli arranged the teapots and cups neatly.

Zhao Sumei sat behind the counter, with an abacus, account book, and change box all available.

Lin Jing was wearing a newly made red shirt and sitting on the small bench next to the counter, very well behaved.

At ten o'clock in the morning, the doors officially opened.

There were already more than a dozen people lined up at the door.

As soon as the door opened, everyone rushed in.

"Boss! Here are two meat buns!"

"I want a bowl of Yangchun noodles!"

"I heard that your family has braised pork rice? Come get one!"

"Is it true that buy one beer and get one free?"

Sun Xiaoli served tea and water, Wang Dazhu passed the dishes to the waiter, and Zhao Zhijun was sweating profusely in the kitchen.

Lin Guoqiang stood in front of the stove, holding a spoon in one hand and seasoning in the other.

The four stove eyes come in turn, in an orderly manner.

Zhao Sumei was sitting at the counter, collecting money and giving change, and the beads on the abacus were clattering.

Twelve tables, turned over three times.

By two o'clock in the afternoon, most of the prepared ingredients were sold.

Lin Guoqiang quickly asked Wang Dazhu to go to the market to restock.

Meat, vegetables, tofu, eggs, and another tricycle came back.

In the evening, a middle-aged man wearing glasses came.

"Boss, can you reserve a table here?"

Lin Guoqiang wiped his hands: "Yes, six yuan, eight yuan, ten yuan, three basic grades, and high-end packages from ten yuan to fifteen yuan.

Minimum order for ten people or more, one day in advance."

"My old mother is celebrating her birthday on June 28th. I would like to book six tables for ten yuan a table."

Zhao Sumei's hand that was turning the abacus stopped.

Six tables.

Ten yuan a table.

Sixty bucks.

The middle-aged man looked at the menu and then at the bustling scene in the store.

"Okay, it's your house. Here's the deposit, ten yuan."

He took out a large bill and placed it on the counter.

When Zhao Sumei collected the money and issued the invoice, her hands were shaking.
